reviewNotes: Direct English editorial review of bundle rewards, letters and all profession branches. Profession labels follow stable glossary IDs, including Săpător and Brută. Every percentage, additive bonus, probability condition and halving is preserved. PV abbreviates puncte de viață, the glossary explanation of Health/HP. The recipe placeholder is governed by de gătit/confecționare.

JunimoNote_MustBeAtCC.source: Must be deposited at Community Center

JunimoNote_MustBeAtAJM.source: Must be deposited at Abandoned JojaMart

LetterViewer_LearnedRecipeName.preservationReason: Technical quoted placeholder only; recipe wording is supplied by the translated recipe name.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Rancher.translation: Produsele animale valorează cu 20% mai mult.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Coopmaster.source:
Befriend coop animals quicker.
Incubation time cut in half.
LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Coopmaster.translation:
Te împrietenești mai repede cu animalele din coteț.
Timpul de incubare se reduce la jumătate.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Shepherd.source:
Befriend barn animals quicker.
Sheep produce wool faster.
LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Shepherd.translation:
Te împrietenești mai repede cu animalele din grajd.
Oile produc lână mai repede.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Artisan.source: Artisan goods (wine, cheese, oil, etc.) worth 40% more.
LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Artisan.translation: Produsele artizanale (vin, brânză, ulei etc.) valorează cu 40% mai mult.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Agricultur.translation: Toate culturile cresc cu 10% mai repede.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Trapper.source: Resources required to craft crab pots reduced.
LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Trapper.translation: Ai nevoie de mai puține resurse pentru a confecționa capcane pentru crabi.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Pirate.translation: Șansa de a găsi comori se dublează.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Mariner.source: Crab pots no longer produce junk items.
LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Mariner.translation: Capcanele pentru crabi nu mai adună vechituri.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Luremaster.source: Crab pots no longer require bait.
LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Luremaster.translation: Capcanele pentru crabi nu mai au nevoie de momeală.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Forester.translation: Copacii lasă cu 25% mai mult lemn.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Gatherer.source: Chance for double harvest of foraged items.
LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Gatherer.translation: Ai șansa de a aduna de două ori mai multe obiecte la cules.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Lumberjack.source: All trees have a chance to drop hardwood.
LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Lumberjack.translation: Orice copac are șansa să lase lemn de esență tare.

LevelUp_ProfessionName_Botanist.preservationReason: Approved Romanian glossary profession; independently reviewed Romanian homograph.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Botanist.source: Foraged items are always highest quality.
LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Botanist.translation: Obiectele culese au întotdeauna cea mai înaltă calitate.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Tracker.translation: Îți arată unde se află obiectele de cules.

LevelUp_ProfessionName_Miner.preservationReason: Approved Romanian glossary profession; independently reviewed Romanian homograph.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Geologist.source: Chance for gems to appear in pairs.
LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Geologist.translation: Nestematele au șansa să apară în perechi.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Blacksmith.translation: Lingourile metalice valorează cu 50% mai mult.

LevelUp_ProfessionName_Prospector.preservationReason: Approved Romanian glossary profession; independently reviewed Romanian homograph.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Prospector.translation: Șansa de a găsi cărbune se dublează.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Excavator.translation: Șansa de a găsi geode se dublează.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Fighter.translation: Toate atacurile provoacă cu 10% mai multe daune.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Scout.translation: Șansa de lovitură critică crește cu 50%.

LevelUp_ProfessionName_Acrobat.preservationReason: Approved Romanian glossary profession; independently reviewed Romanian homograph.

LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Acrobat.source: Cooldown on special moves cut in half.
LevelUp_ProfessionDescription_Acrobat.translation: Timpul de reîncărcare al mișcărilor speciale se reduce la jumătate.
